request.description: Runs matching for the analysis's application (or reads the latest run once submitted). `id` is the match result to apply with, `verified` marks eligible products (the app shows only those), `interest` is the product's pricing disclosure. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.

response.name: 200 OK
